gear: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one complete game navigation button for a children’s fantasy adventure in a warm observatory. Transparent PNG cutout. Object: a clear recognizable tan leather and midnight-blue explorer backpack with one brass buckle, placed on and visually joined to a wide pale wooden label plaque with softly rounded corners and a narrow warm brass rim. No words or letters anywhere. The plaque is blank and clean for native UI text; it spans almost the full width of the button, its central blank area sits at y=78-90% of the square canvas. Backpack occupies upper 70%, not overlapping the plaque blank area. Polished hand-painted volumetric children's game art, soft material shading, restrained detail and very readable at small mobile size. Front three-quarter view backpack, front-on plaque. Square 1024 canvas, full button within x=5-95%, y=5-94%, consistent comfortable margins. No scene, no background, no glow, no sparkles, no text, no ground shadow outside the cutout. Match warm brass, tan leather, deep blue of existing app art. Make an inviting cohesive tactile button, not a separate icon floating over a label.
